dedupe_keys.name: osm2rail build railway modelling datasets from openstreetmap

description: OSM2Rail is an open-source education tool for constructing railway transport modelling datasets from OpenStreetMap. Its PyPI description says it integrates and enhances two packages: OSM2GMNS, which converts OpenStreetMap data to node and link files in the General Modeling Network Specification (GMNS) and is developed at Arizona State University, and PyDriosm, from the Birmingham Centre for Railway Research and Education, which downloads and reads OpenStreetMap extracts in PBF and shapefile formats from Geofabrik and BBBike with PostgreSQL input and output. Authors are Jiawei Lu, Qian Fu, Zanyang Cui and Junhua Chen. PyPI gives version 0.0.6 under the Apache 2.0 licence. Coverage: any railway mapped in OpenStreetMap. Format and access: Python package. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: an early version aimed at teaching, and output quality depends on OpenStreetMap tagging. It supports network flow and capacity planning models of rail networks. It relates to OpenStreetMap, GMNS, OpenRailwayMap and GTFS2GMNS in the catalogue.
